cover_letter.greeting: Dear Chase Auto Commercial Solutions Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate role in Commercial Solutions Pitch Strategy & Execution at Chase Auto. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role appeals to me because it sits right next to the bankers and TMOs, turning what they know about a dealer into a pitch that fits that dealer.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, where I created data-driven pitch materials and dashboards that brought financial projections into funding discussions, and built forecasts and scenario models that improved capital efficiency by 15%. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, benchmarked past allocations to find 30% in efficiency gains, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership.

Building templates, tailoring decks to a prospect, closing information gaps and keeping follow-ups moving are things I've done in some form, and I like owning a process end to end. I'd bring that to the intake and pitch support work for your bankers. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Senior Associate, Commercial Solutions Pitch Strategy & Execution role at Chase Auto. Before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management and at Lenovo, where I built pitch materials and dashboards for funding decisions. I'd love to hear how the team supports the bankers day to day. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
